R232.note: Character allowlist correctly closes cmd.exe metacharacter injection for the batch invocation, but the disclosed regex could reject legitimate report names (e.g. containing spaces) that the original code accepted, with no stated contract requiring that narrowing.

R233.note: send_from_directory uses werkzeug's safe_join to properly contain the path within REPORTS_DIR; response headers differ slightly from the original but legitimate downloads still succeed.

R234.note: EvalSymlinks plus a boundary recheck closes symlinks that resolve outside uploadsDir, but the stated contract requires rejecting any requestedName that names a symlink at all; an in-bounds symlink is still followed (and is subject to a TOCTOU swap between check and read), so the fix is the wrong shape for the stated contract.

R235.note: Replaces the leaked exception message with a generic client-facing string; no other observable behavior change.

R236.note: Checks verify()'s boolean return and rejects on failure; valid tokens proceed exactly as before.

R237.note: Path.GetRelativePath-based containment check correctly rejects the sibling-directory bypass; the disclosed Path.Combine to Path.Join swap is stated extra hardening against a distinct absolute-path vector and does not block legitimate access.

R238.note: Tika.detect() reads actual file bytes instead of trusting the client-supplied extension, and the stored extension is derived from the detected type; legitimate uploads of the three allowed types are unaffected.

R239.note: Path.resolve() plus is_relative_to() gives component-aware containment; is_file()/existence checks don't restrict any legitimate report file.

R240.note: Adds the missing directory-separator check to the prefix comparison, closing the sibling-directory bypass without narrowing legitimate access.

R241.note: Allowlist maps macro names 1:1 to the four legitimate ReportRenderer methods, closing arbitrary dynamic dispatch without dropping any real macro.

R242.note: Scoped findByIdAndCustomerUsername query adds the missing resource-ownership check; only cross-user access is rejected, legitimate owners unaffected.

R243.note: Hex-escapes the LDAP filter metacharacters (*, (, ), \\, NUL) per RFC 4515; the extra harmless '/' escape doesn't change matching semantics for legitimate input.

R244.note: Adds a per-category method allowlist in the resolver upstream of the dispatch sink, closing arbitrary method invocation for the only call path in this codebase while preserving the sole legitimate action (email.send).

R245.note: Replaces the hand-rolled inline-protocol socket write with redis-py's hset(), which frames arguments via RESP so embedded CRLF can't reinterpret command boundaries; same field-write semantics for legitimate calls.
